subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept replacing Node fs.glob with this custom yielding walker for bootstrap-extra-files using the current parity coverage, or require broader glob compatibility proof before merge?
rationale: The patch fixes the implicated event-loop stall without growing the public SDK, but the custom walker changes a compatibility-sensitive config path whose uncommon glob parity cannot be fully proven by normal CI.

options.title: Accept Current Coverage
options.body: Proceed after a refreshed exact-head check if maintainers accept the residual risk around uncommon glob syntax because the reported and common bootstrap-extra-files cases are covered.

options.title: Require One More Glob Probe
options.body: Ask for a focused test or live output for any nonstandard bootstrap-extra-files pattern maintainers believe existing users rely on.

options.title: Hold For Different Seam
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer a smaller wrapper around Node glob or a broader scheduler or worker-thread approach instead of owning a custom walker.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Coverage
recommendation.body: Proceed after a refreshed exact-head check if maintainers accept the residual risk around uncommon glob syntax because the reported and common bootstrap-extra-files cases are covered.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is an architecture and SDK-boundary tradeoff on the bootstrap and hook path, where history shows the strongest ownership signal.
